options.name: hz-backend
options.description: 后端开发 — 按技术方案实现 API、数据库、业务逻辑和数据同步。

options.name: hz-frontend
options.description: 前端开发 — 按设计稿和技术方案实现页面、组件、交互逻辑和状态管理。

options.name: hz-pm
options.description: 产品经理 — 初始化项目文档、创建需求、拆解业务任务、定义验收标准，只关注业务层面不涉及技术实现。

options.name: hz-qa
options.description: QA 测试 — 设计测试策略、执行 API 和 E2E 测试、记录 Bug、验证验收标准。

options.name: hz-tech-lead
options.description: 开发总管 — 技术架构设计、创建角色目录、拆解前后端技术任务、协调 API 契约、管理 AutoCode 生成。

options.name: hz-ui
options.description: UI 设计师 — 用 HTML+Tailwind 制作可预览设计稿、建立设计系统、产出设计资源、审查前端视觉还原度。

options.name: understand-anything:architecture-analyzer
options.description:
Analyzes a codebase's file structure, summaries, and import relationships to identify
logical architectural layers and assign every file to exactly one layer.

options.name: understand-anything:article-analyzer
options.description: Analyzes markdown files using pre-parsed structural data and LLM inference to extract knowledge graph nodes and edges (entities, claims, implicit relationships, topic clustering).

options.name: understand-anything:assemble-reviewer
options.description:
Reviews the output of merge-batch-graphs.py for semantic issues the script
cannot catch. Recovers dropped nodes/edges and fills cross-batch gaps.

options.name: understand-anything:domain-analyzer
options.description: Analyzes codebases to extract business domain knowledge — domains, business flows, and process steps. Produces a domain-graph.json that maps how business logic flows through the code.

options.name: understand-anything:file-analyzer
options.description:
Analyzes batches of source files to produce knowledge graph nodes and edges.
Extracts file structure, functions, classes, and relationships using a two-phase
approach: structural extraction script followed by LLM semantic analysis.

options.name: understand-anything:graph-reviewer
options.description:
Validates knowledge graphs for correctness, completeness, and quality.
Runs systematic checks and renders approval or rejection decisions.

options.name: understand-anything:knowledge-graph-guide
options.description:
Use this agent when users need help understanding, querying, or working
with an Understand-Anything knowledge graph. Guides users through graph
structure, node/edge relationships, layer architecture, tours, and
dashboard usage.

options.name: understand-anything:project-scanner
options.description:
Scans a codebase directory to produce a structured inventory of all project files,
detected languages, frameworks, import maps, and estimated complexity.

options.name: understand-anything:tour-builder
options.description:
Designs guided learning tours through codebases, creating 5-15 pedagogical steps
that teach project architecture and key concepts in logical order.
